import torch.nn as nn

            nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0)
        )
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(in_features=64 * 7 * 7, out_features=128)

    def forward(self, x):

        x = self.sequential2(x)

        x = self.linear2(x)
